_doc: Golden submission set for AI Reviewer regression evaluation. Each entry is a closed interaction whose 'expected' answers represent the human-judged ground truth for the audit form. Set 'expected' to null until a human has graded the interaction — runEval skips ungraded records (reports them as 'unscored') instead of failing. The four gradeable question_ids on form 99016 are 99125-99128 (all YES_NO). Phase B (B5) added a 'kind' field per record: 'TICKET' (default, replays through analyzeTicket) or 'CALL' (replays through analyzeConversation; requires conversation_id with the Genesys conversation id string). Records that omit 'kind' are treated as TICKET. Add 5-10 call entries below as real call corrections accumulate in ai_calibration_data with source_kind='CALL'.
